strings.name: Reshma Kewalramani
strings.summary: Kewalramani moved from nephrology into drug development at Amgen, then Vertex, becoming president and CEO in 2020. She leads expansion beyond cystic fibrosis, including gene editing with CRISPR Therapeutics and non-opioid pain treatment. These are collaborative achievements; access, clinical risk and business decisions also determine their practical value.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Leads Vertex Pharmaceuticals, advancing innovative drug development and biopharmaceutical management.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in Mumbai, India; moved to the United States with her family as a child.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: BU seven-year liberal-arts/medical program (1998); Harvard executive-management training.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Physician to drug developer
strings.highlights.h1.text: Brings internal-medicine and nephrology training into clinical research and leadership.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Broader treatment portfolio
strings.highlights.h2.text: Leads expansion from cystic fibrosis into gene therapy, pain and other diseases.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Third-quarter progress reported
strings.timeline.t1.text: Reported Crinetics acquisition closing; the renal candidate’s regulatory review remained incomplete.
strings.timeline.t2.title: BU commencement address
strings.timeline.t2.text: Delivered the address and received an honorary science doctorate, distinct from her 1998 medical degree.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Journavx FDA approval
strings.timeline.t3.text: Non-opioid suzetrigine approved for moderate-to-severe acute pain in adults.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Casgevy FDA approval
strings.timeline.t4.text: Therapy developed with CRISPR Therapeutics approved for eligible sickle-cell patients.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Became president and CEO
strings.timeline.t5.text: Took office on 1 April, leading research and operations during the pandemic.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joined Vertex
strings.timeline.t6.text: Moved from Amgen and became chief medical officer in 2018.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Moved to Amgen
strings.timeline.t7.text: Left clinical practice for drug development and medical affairs.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completed BU medical education
strings.timeline.t8.text: Finished the seven-year program before internal-medicine and nephrology training.
